key_insight: QuTuner improves quantum compiler pass tuning by combining static circuit structure features with optimization-aware embeddings that capture how circuits respond to passes.
engineering_relevance: This gives compiler engineers a practical way to automate pass-sequence selection across different quantum compilers while lowering tuning time and improving circuit-cost reduction.
method: Builds a large optimization dataset from quantum circuits and compiler pass outcomes.
Learns two offline models: one to retrieve candidate pass sequences and one to rank them for unseen circuits.
Uses both static circuit features and pass-response embeddings, then applies lightweight refinement.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on Qiskit and PyTKET benchmark suites, QuTuner achieved up to 84.85% better metric reduction on Qiskit and up to 18.68% on PyTKET, while also cutting tuning time by 73.59% and 64.49%, respectively.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the coverage and quality of the optimization dataset, so transferring to new compilers or hardware-specific cost models may require re-training or recalibration.
paper_title: QuTuner: Feature- and Learning-Guided Optimization Pass Tuning for Quantum Compilers
